question: Related Questions Q. Under what circumstances is one allowed to recite the takbir of Allahu Akbar, outside of prayer and supplication 1425 views Q. I am having a lot of trouble in my marriage of 12 years - my husband keeps doubting me and bad mouths me to his and my family and friends. I have sworn on the Quraan that I have not done anything wrong but he fails to understand. He abuses me infront of the neighbors and does not talk to me or sleep with me. This has been going on for the past few years. He is very very 'Shaqqi' - I have tried to make him understand and tried to always go to him and make him understand but his 'ana' / ego is such that he will be ok for a few days and then again start asking me for money - for the past few years he has not supported me financially and always asks me what I do with my money. Please help me - I am a working mother of 2 kids in the US. Please write the dua in English since I am not very well versed with Arabic, i am still learning, Insha Allah. 1988 views Q. Suppose there are two hadith that contradict each other like saying Amen loudly or silently 1977 views Q. Assalam -o- Alaikum, Mufti Saab, I have a problem with my ears i.e. tinnitus (ringing of bell). I have this problem for almost 3 years. I consulted as many good doctors that i could but found no satisfactory answer regarding the cure. All says 2 things 1. use hearing aid, 2. Operation. And as far as i have knowledge, most of the surguries on ear fails even in uk and usa. The voice is irritating and bacomes more intense during ZUKAAM. I am currently trying homeopathic madicines but they are not effective and also using hearing aid. I wrote this question in the light that Our beloved Prophet (Peace be up on him) has tought many things to his Sahaba. There might be a cure for tinnitus. Kindly reply at your earliest. Best regards Allah Hafiz. 7411 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 6029 Country: India Title: salam , mery wife ko 2 month chal raha hai bo maa banee bale hai uske leya quran pak ki kiss surat ko parne chaye. Question: salam , mery wife ko 2 month chal raha hai bo maa banee bale hai uske leya quran pak ki kiss surat ko parne chaye. Answer ID: 6029 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 662/626=L -1429) She should often recite Surah Maryam and both of you should recite the below duas: ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة وقنا عذاب النار ربنا هب لنا من ازواجنا و ذرياتنا قرة أعين و اجعلنا للمتقين إماما In-sha-Allah, Allah Almighty will bless you a pious child. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
